title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo para Pequeos Productores Vitivincolas de Argentina II (PROVIAR II)
Support Program for Small Wine Producers in Argentina II (PROVIAR II)

description.narrative: El Objetivo General del Programa es contribuir a la sustentabilidad social, econmica y ambiental de la vitivinicultura argentina, en particular, de los pequeos y medianos productores, establecimientos vitivincolas y jvenes rurales. Como objetivos especficos, el programa propone: (i) mejorar los niveles de productividad de pequeos y medianos productores vitivincolas con enfoque en eficiencia del uso de recursos hdricos; (ii) incrementar las ventas de pequeos y medianos establecimientos vitivincolas; y (iii) fortalecer las pequeas y medianas empresas (PyMEs) del sector rural para generar empleo e incrementar ventas con un enfoque en jvenes y mujeres.

The general objective of the Program is to contribute to the social, economic and environmental sustainability of Argentine viticulture, in particular, of small and medium producers, viticultural establishments and rural youth. As specific objectives, the program proposes to: (i) improve the productivity levels of small and medium wine producers with a focus on efficiency in the use of water resources; (ii) increase the sales of small and medium-sized wine establishments; and (iii) strengthen small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the rural sector to generate employment and increase sales with a focus on youth and women.
